{{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=February 2013}} {{Infobox NCAA team season |mode=Basketball |year=2011–12 |team=Wichita State Shockers |image=Wichita State Shockers alternate logo.svg |image_size=250 |conference=Missouri Valley Conference |short_conf=MVC |CoachRank= |APRank= 18 |record= 27–6 |conf_record= 16–2 |head_coach=[[Gregg Marshall]] |asst_coach1=[[Chris Jans]] |asst_coach2=Greg Heiar |asst_coach3=Dana Ford |stadium=[[Charles Koch Arena]] (10,506) |champion=Missouri Valley Conference regular season Champions |bowl=NCAA Tournament |bowl_result=Round of 64 }} {{2011–12 Missouri Valley Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2011–12 Wichita State Shockers men's basketball team''' represented [[Wichita State University]] in the [[2011–12 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The team, played in the [[Missouri Valley Conference]], and were led by fifth-year head coach [[Gregg Marshall]]. The Shockers played their home games at [[Charles Koch Arena]]. They finished with a 16–2 conference record to be crowned Missouri Valley Conference regular season champions. In the 2012 Missouri Valley Conference Tournament, they beat Indiana State in the quarterfinals before losing to Illinois State in the semifinals. They received an at-large bid to the [[2012 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament]] for their first NCAA Tournament appearance since 2006 and earned No. 5 seed in the South Region where they were defeated by VCU in the second round to end the season with 27–6 record. ==Roster== {{CBB roster/Header|year=2011|team=Wichita State Shockers|teamcolors=y|high_school=y}} {{CBB roster/Player|first=Joe|last=Ragland|link=y|num=1|pos=G|ft=6|in=0|lbs=185|class=sr|rs=|home=[[West Springfield, Massachusetts|West Springfield, MA]] |high_school=[[West Springfield High School (Massachusetts)|West Springfield]]
